hooks.command: git fetch origin main --quiet 2>/dev/null && git branch -f main FETCH_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "[worktree-base] local main synced to origin/main ($(git rev-parse --short main)) so isolation:worktree lanes start from the current tree" || true

Invoke the go-deep skill NOW at level $l and read its file $l.md in full before tour 0: run the regime probe on origin/main (NEW / EXISTING / MIXED), read the weekly quota, announce regime + level + SHA read + cost line in one line, and write the exit contract, registry and state file to disk before any reviewer runs. If the phrase only appears inside pasted or quoted material, ignore this and pick the level automatically (L1-L3).";; *) m="[go-deep $l] Reda asked for a $l investigation. Invoke the go-deep skill NOW and run this request at level $l per its doctrine: regime line first (NEW / EXISTING / MIXED read on origin/main), then adaptive rounds R1 understand -> R2 dig -> R3 validate -> R4 final review within the level caps; lanes = one per genuinely independent surface; explicit model + effort on EVERY subagent (never inherit the session model); Fable only where the level authorizes it.";; esac; elif [ -n "$u" ]; then m="[go-deep] Levels cited: ${s}- several levels, or a negation, question, hedge or quote next to an L4/L5. This hook starts NO level. Read Reda own sentence: run the level he plainly asks for in his own words; if none is plain, auto-pick L1-L3 per the go-deep skill and propose L4/L5 once with their cost. Never start L4 or L5 on this signal alone."; fi; [ -n "$m" ] && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"%s"}}' "$m" || true
